chapter: Jelly Roll Morton and other records
title: Drummer Andrew Hilaire
summary: Mitchell remembers Hilaire as a good, reading drummer from Louisiana who has since died.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how

blocks.x: Oh, I was wondering about the drummer on those Jelly Roll records, Andrew Hilaire. Hilaire, Andrew Hilaire. I never got to meet him. I guess he died a couple years ago.

Yes, he died. And he was a very good drummer. And he's a good musician too. He could read. He could read. He could read. And he had that, uh, had a good rhythm too. Yeah, sounds fine on him. Yes, Hilaire was good. Hilaire was good. But, uh, I don't think he, uh, got around. But no, I don't think he, he played around Chicago yet, but I don't think. But he was from Louisiana too. Oh, I didn't know where he came from. Yeah, he's from Louisiana. That's right.
